title: The eight Published WordPress quickstarts keep their template-layer fixes: translatable interface words, no English date formats, declared demo names, a profile row per new version
steps: S1: For each of wp-ja-essence, wp-ja-impact, wp-ja-kinetic, wp-ja-morgan, wp-ja-nova, wp-ja-vega, tracy-base and wp-tracy-business, read every templates/*.html and every parts/*.html of packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/<theme>/ that the new contract's presentation lock does not list as a database template part, through the readiness reader hard-coded-words.js.
S2: Read every .php and .html file of those themes through english-date-formats.js (PHP date calls and date block formats).

S3: Read <version>.copy.json of contracts ja-essence/wp7/1.0.17, ja-impact/wp7/1.0.8, ja-kinetic/wp7/1.0.8, ja-morgan/wp7/1.1.13, ja-nova/wp7/1.1.11, ja-vega/wp7/1.1.13, tracy-base/wp7/1.1.3 and tracy-business/wp7/1.3.5 in packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-quickstart/contracts.
S4: Read apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-profiles.json for the same eight release tags and versions.
expect: S1: no interface word written outside a translation in any of those files.
S3: each copy file's demoCompanyNames renames that release's demo blogname (JA Essence, JA Impact, Kinetic, JA Morgan, ja_nova, JA Vega, Tracy Base, Northgate).
S4: each release has a row for its new version.
evidence: Template Customization Question Readiness on each new pack (12/10/2026): 0 FAIL for all eight; on the served versions the same check failed LANG-2, LANG-6, ABOUT-3 and the logo/profile rules
fence: The readiness check's own readers over the shipped theme source and the contract data in the tree; the script exits non-zero when any step finds a problem
